ticket.title: Repoint downstream crates onto gaugeblock-contracts and remove the duplicated definitions

decisions.question: Where should contract-type behaviour live once members re-export gaugeblock-contracts types?
proposed_options: A: Move behaviour into contracts — relocate constructors (InferenceRequest::new, TypedHole::new), Display for GrammarFormat and task helpers (AgentClaim::is_expired, slug generation) into gaugeblock-contracts so members re-export types+behaviour; contracts stays pure (no I/O).
B: Keep definitions in members — contracts remains a documentation mirror for cross-language consumers only; members keep owning their types, so no orphan-rule problem and no schema churn.
C: Newtype wrappers — members wrap each contract type in a tuple struct that carries their impls; wire shape is preserved via transparent serde, at the cost of double definitions.

D: Hybrid — pure-data types (outfeed, miter) re-export from contracts; behaviour-rich types (storypole, sawhorse, dado, batten) stay local until their extra fields (e.g. DadoPattern::canonical_example_fills) are reconciled into CONTRACTS.md.
decisions.rationale: After reconciling CONTRACTS.md with the implementations the schema uncertainty that motivated option D is gone, so the only open question is behaviour placement. The four impls are pure and infallible (InferenceRequest::new, TypedHole::new, Display for GrammarFormat, AgentClaim::is_expired) and inherent impls travel with a re-exported type, so sawhorse_core::InferenceRequest::new keeps compiling with no newtype indirection; the impls live in the crate that owns the type, so the orphan rule is satisfied. Option D would have preserved four duplicate definitions - exactly the drift this ticket just repaired. miter's internal Language/SymbolKind remain internal and are bridged by a From conversion written in miter.

acceptance_criteria: gaugeblock-contracts carries the pure helpers; each member re-exports the type; no duplicate wire definitions remain; member public APIs unchanged.

completed_items: Five of six members repointed onto gaugeblock-contracts under option A: outfeed-core (83c97a7), batten-core (33a6286), sawhorse-core (c190b9b), dado-core+cli+mcp (c88b13c, which also deleted a custom serde shim), miter-engine (040f29a, bidirectional language bridge plus a lock test). Contracts gained the pure behaviour the members needed: InferenceRequest builders, TypedHole::new, Display/Hash for GrammarFormat, Hash for ModelRole, AgentClaim::is_expired and TaskEdge::{new,with_target_meta} (bd9d938). Wire Language is now the 13-format lowercase taxonomy with lenient aliases, mirrored in CONTRACTS.md. Roughly 600 lines of duplicated wire definitions removed with no consumer API change.
remaining_items: storypole-core is the last member. Audit already done: LedgerEvent has 14 variants with matching payloads in both crates, and TaskEdge (moved) plus AgentClaim::is_expired (already in contracts) were the only inherent impls on the repointed types. Remaining work is mechanical but must land in one commit because model/{task,decision,events,config}.rs reference each other: replace the local TaskKind, TaskStatus, EdgeKind, TaskEdge, DecisionStatus, TaskDecision, TaskScope, TaskNode, TaskPlan, PlanStep, AgentClaim, HandoffPacket, VerificationReceipt, TaskContextBriefing, LedgerEvent, StorypoleConfig, WorkspaceConfig and DiscoveredMember definitions with re-exports from gaugeblock_contracts, delete the two now-duplicated impls, keep every free function and the store/ledger replay code. Verify with cargo nextest run --workspace plus a real scratch-store round trip (init, add, claim, verify) to prove ledger replay still works, then chalkline docs check -d storypole.

verification_receipt.summary: All six members now consume gaugeblock-contracts: outfeed-core (83c97a7), batten-core (33a6286), sawhorse-core (c190b9b), dado-core+cli+mcp (c88b13c), miter-engine (040f29a) and storypole-core (5ffb991). Contracts carries the wire types plus the pure behaviour that travelled with them (InferenceRequest builders, TypedHole::new, Display/Hash for GrammarFormat, Hash and Default for ModelRole/TaskKind, AgentClaim::is_expired, TaskEdge builders) and the 13-format lowercase Language with lenient aliases. Roughly 1150 lines of duplicated wire definitions removed with no consumer API change. Proven beyond unit tests: the 840+ event meta-harness ledger replays through the repointed types (storypole list exit 0), sawhorse keys its role map on the contract enum, and dado/miter/batten gates are green.

completed_items: Pilot repoint merged to outfeed main (83c97a7): outfeed-core now depends on gaugeblock-contracts 0.1.0-beta.1 (resolved locally via [patch.crates-io]) and re-exports CommitInfo, ConventionalKind, BumpType, ManifestDiff, ReleasePlan, SuiteLock, SuiteMetadata and SuiteToolEntry, deleting 8 duplicated definitions (-138/+28 lines). Public paths (outfeed_core::model::commits, ::model::plans, ::suite_lock) are unchanged, so callers see no difference. Gates: fmt OK, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, nextest --workspace 67/67 unchanged, docs check 9/9.
remaining_items: Repoint the remaining definition owners, one repo per commit with its own gate: storypole-core (TaskNode/TaskDecision/etc. are co-located with inherent impls such as AgentClaim::is_expired and slug generation, so the re-export must keep those impls next to the type - likely a contracts re-export plus a local impl block), sawhorse-core (ExecutionMode/InferenceRequest/InferenceResponse/ModelRole), miter-engine + miter-ast (Language/SymbolBinding/LexicalScope/VerificationReport), dado-core (DadoPattern/TypedHole) and batten-core (CompiledGrammarConstraint/GrammarFormat). Also publish gaugeblock-contracts and gaugeblock-common at 0.1.0-beta.1 before any member that names them is released, otherwise standalone member builds fail to resolve the dependency.

completed_items: Pilot repoint landed (outfeed 83c97a7): outfeed-core consumes gaugeblock-contracts and deleted 8 duplicated pure-data definitions with zero API change. Investigated the next four members and found the repoint is NOT mechanical there: sawhorse InferenceRequest has an inherent new(); dado TypedHole has new() and DadoPattern carries an extra canonical_example_fills field absent from CONTRACTS.md; batten implements Display for GrammarFormat; storypole TaskNode/AgentClaim carry lease and slug helpers. Rust rejects inherent impls on re-exported foreign types (E0116), so behaviour placement must be decided first. Raised decision 37ce2855-05e9-403f-bbb3-7e9e62c43f09 with four options (A move behaviour into contracts, B keep local owners, C newtype wrappers, D hybrid).
remaining_items: Resolve the pending decision, then repoint per option: for A add constructors/Display/helpers to gaugeblock-contracts; for D reconcile the dado/dado_pattern and typed_hole schema drift (canonical_example_fills, ast_node_kind, description, kind, max_tokens) into CONTRACTS.md before swapping dado/batten. Also publish gaugeblock-contracts and gaugeblock-common at 0.1.0-beta.1 before any member naming them is released.
